input: hey! our 5th wedding anniversery is coming up and i want to take my wife somewhere special for dinner in fukuoka. saturday 14 november around 19:00, just the 2 of us, somewhere central like hakata, nakasu or tenjin. the star has to be sashimi from local genkai sea fish, honestly the freshest sashimi you can possibly get, ideally a place where the fish comes straight out of the tank in front of you. want a real wow moment she'll remember, a proper authentic fukuoka seafood experience. counter or private room so its quiet. max 30,000 yen for both incl the course. can you book the best one?

experiences.name: Kappo Isohama – Anniversary Aji Ikejime Course
experiences.description: A counter course for two, made for special nights. One aji is netted from our 2-tonne seawater counter tank in full view, spiked through the brain (ikejime) within seconds of leaving the tank and before any cutting, then sliced and arranged as whole-fish sashimi on the plate. Afterwards the frame goes back to the kitchen to be fried. Aji are bought each morning at Nagahama Fish Market from Genkai Sea boats. Includes appetizer, sashimi, fried frame, miso soup and rice. Seatings from 19:00 every evening, including Saturdays.

experiences.name: Kaisen Kappo Shiokaze – Anniversary Aji Ikizukuri Course
experiences.description: A counter course for two, made for celebrations. One aji is netted from our 2-tonne seawater counter tank right before your eyes, filleted at the counter while still alive and arranged as sashimi on its own body, arriving with its gills and tail still moving. The frame is fried crisp afterwards. Aji are bought each morning at Nagahama Fish Market from Genkai Sea boats. Includes appetizer, sashimi, fried frame, miso soup and rice. Evening seatings from 19:00, Saturdays included.

experiences.name: Tofu Kaiseki Mameya
experiences.description: Tofu made fresh in-house every day from Kyushu-grown soybeans, served across an eight-course kaiseki for two. Expect warm zaru tofu, yudofu and a soy milk hot pot, with every broth built on kombu-only dashi. Counter seating looks out onto a small moss garden. Dinner from 18:30 to 21:30, Saturdays included.

experiences.name: Kappo Genkai-an – Celebration Genkai Ikejime Course
experiences.description: Celebrate in a private room seating up to four. The heart of this seven-dish course for two is a Genkai Sea madai and seasonal fish sashimi platter, carved by the chef at your table. Every fish is spiked through the brain (ikejime) within seconds of landing, and its spinal cord is then cleared with a wire (shinkei-jime) before it leaves the market. Collected from Nagahama Fish Market at 7:00 and brought in on ice the same morning. Sake pairing available. Dinner from 19:00 on Saturdays.

experiences.name: Hakata Ryotei Minato – Celebration Tai Ikizukuri Course
experiences.description: Mark the occasion in a tatami private room. For this seven-dish celebration course for two, a madai is taken from the seawater tank in our kitchen, filleted while still alive and brought to your table as whole-fish sashimi on a decorated platter, its mouth and gills still moving. The head is later simmered. Madai are sourced via Nagahama Fish Market from Genkai Sea boats. Sake pairing available. Dinner from 19:00 on Saturdays.

experiences.name: Shojin Ryori Kogetsu – Anniversary Course
experiences.description: A quiet anniversary course for two in a private tatami room, a short walk from Shofukuji Temple. Nine small dishes of seasonal vegetables from Itoshima farms, built on kombu and shiitake dashi, including house-made sesame tofu and yuba 'sashimi' with fresh wasabi. Evening seatings from 19:00, Saturdays included.

experiences.name: Kawasemi Riverside Sake Bar – Anniversary Tasting Flight
experiences.description: Six sake from Fukuoka and Saga breweries, poured as an anniversary tasting flight for two and paired with house pickles and charcoal-grilled seasonal vegetables. Window seats overlook the lights on the Naka River. Open from 18:00, Saturdays included; reserve ahead for a window seat.
